nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Parses flags (config prometheus.yml, listen 0.0.0.0:9090), opens TSDB, starts managers

nodes.label: scrape.Manager
nodes.desc: Holds target sets keyed by pool name; ApplyConfig rebuilds them on reload

nodes.label: Manager.Run
nodes.desc: Consumes target groups from discovery and calls reload to sync loops

nodes.label: scrapeLoop
nodes.desc: One goroutine per target: interval ticker, jitter, staleness handling

nodes.label: scrapeLoop.run
nodes.desc: Ticks each interval and delegates to scrapeAndReport

nodes.label: scrapeAndReport
nodes.desc: HTTP GET of /metrics, protobuf/text decode, up + scrape_duration metrics

nodes.label: DB
nodes.desc: Storage facade owning head, block list, compaction goroutine

nodes.label: Open
nodes.desc: Opens the TSDB dir, loads persisted blocks, replays WAL into head

nodes.label: DB.Appender
nodes.desc: Wraps head appender; scrape loops call it per scrape batch

nodes.label: Head
nodes.desc: In-memory head: mem series map, m-mapped chunks, out-of-order window

nodes.label: headAppender.Append
nodes.desc: Series lookup/creation, sample ordering checks, chunk encoding

nodes.label: WL.Log
nodes.desc: Pages, compresses and writes WAL records; segments via SegmentName

nodes.label: Head.loadWAL
nodes.desc: Replays WAL records on startup to rebuild head series

nodes.label: DB.Compact
nodes.desc: Head compaction into a block, then deletions for retention

nodes.label: Compactor
nodes.desc: Interface: Plan + Write, chosen by strategy

nodes.label: LeveledCompactor
nodes.desc: Merges blocks into exponentially sized ranges (2h, 10h, 50h...)

nodes.label: BlockReader
nodes.desc: Read interface over a persisted block: index + chunk readers

nodes.label: Engine
nodes.desc: Central query engine with max-concurrency gate and timeout

nodes.label: NewEngine
nodes.desc: Applies EngineOpts: Reg, MaxSamples, Timeout, NoStepSubqueryIntervalFn

nodes.label: NewInstantQuery
nodes.desc: Single-timestamp evaluation entry for /query

nodes.label: NewRangeQuery
nodes.desc: start/end/interval evaluation entry for /query_range

nodes.label: Engine.exec
nodes.desc: Runs a query: computes total time range, tracks active queries

nodes.label: execEvalStmt
nodes.desc: Prepares storage querier, walks the AST with the Evaluator

nodes.label: rules.Manager
nodes.desc: Owns Group objects; Update swaps in new rule files on reload

nodes.label: Group
nodes.desc: Ordered rule set with its own evaluation interval and offset

nodes.label: Group.Eval
nodes.desc: Evaluates recording + alerting rules, appends results via engine

nodes.label: AlertingRule
nodes.desc: Holds alert state machine: pending, firing, for-clause tracking

nodes.label: web.Handler
nodes.desc: Gorilla router with UI, lifecycle endpoints, readiness gating

nodes.label: Handler.Run
nodes.desc: Serves listeners until quit; reload + quit channels wired to main

nodes.label: v1 API
nodes.desc: Registers /query, /query_range, /series, /labels, exemplars routes

nodes.label: api.query
nodes.desc: Instant query endpoint: parses ts, calls engine.NewInstantQuery

nodes.label: api.queryRange
nodes.desc: Range endpoint: validates step, calls engine.NewRangeQuery
